name: Regularity structures
summary: Ill-posed stochastic PDEs are solved by combining rough-path ideas with a Hopf-algebraic account of renormalisation taken from quantum field theory.

name: Rough paths
summary: Lyons gave a pathwise integration theory beyond bounded variation using iterated integrals.

name: Higher-order Fourier analysis
summary: Gowers uniformity norms, matched with Host-Kra ergodic seminorms, produced a nonabelian Fourier theory for polynomial patterns.

name: Additive combinatorics as a field
summary: Structure-versus-randomness for sets with small sumset consolidated into a discipline with a dedicated textbook.

name: Tropical geometry
summary: Algebraic varieties were replaced by piecewise-linear shadows, allowing enumerative problems to be solved by counting combinatorial objects.

name: Donaldson-Thomas theory and wall-crossing
summary: Counting sheaves on Calabi-Yau threefolds gives invariants whose jumps across walls follow universal formulas.

name: Random planar maps and the Brownian map
summary: Bijections for planar maps allow scaling limits to a random metric sphere, linking combinatorics, probability and two-dimensional quantum gravity.

name: Entropy proves the polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa conjecture
summary: Entropy of random variables, rather than sets, is used with a doubling-style argument to settle the polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa conjecture in characteristic 2.

name: Khovanov homology
summary: The Jones polynomial was lifted to a bigraded homology theory, starting a categorification programme.

name: Random matrix universality and Dyson / Tracy-Widom in KPZ
summary: Longest increasing subsequence fluctuations were shown to follow Tracy-Widom, linking random permutations to random matrices.
